question: Which chapter of the Uḍḍāmareśvara Mahātantra concludes at this point?
premises: The text is identified as the Uḍḍāmareśvara Mahātantra.
The section is named the explanation of the mantra treasury.
The ordinal trayodaśaḥ marks it as the thirteenth.
inference: This marks the end of the thirteenth chapter, the explanation of the mantra treasury, in the Uḍḍāmareśvara Mahātantra.
plain_english: In the Uḍḍāmareśvara Mahātantra, this is the thirteenth chapter, the explanation of the mantra treasury.
